The Talos Principle is a wonderful 3D Puzzle game, by Croteam; the guys behind the Serious Sam games. One of the best scores I've heard in a long time, that emanates atmosphere, with great story pacing despite being rather abstract. Seriously, the ending of that game is a sight to see, a game well worth the 10 bucks.

Lisa, a quaint little indie rpg, that is both disturbing and hilarious in the same moment. Rather linear, so go in knowing this, but for anyone looking for a game with dark depressing themes of despair with Earthbound humor, this is the game for you! And it's only 2.50$, so it's hardly a drop in the bucket.

Metro Redux is worth the price if you want an atmosphere rich game, with both stealth an action gameplay. Though go in expecting a linear shooter, but it's a fantastic one, and if you buy the Redux bundle for only 7.50$ you get both Metro games.

Shadow Warrior (2013) is a good little first person shooter, with fun sword combat, plenty of gibs, and a plethora of weapon upgrade. Slice and dice multiple baddies, from Humans to Demons, with an arsenal of fun weapons. I recommend only playing on normal or hard, beyond that the enemies become bullet sponges. Well worth the 4 bucks.

Grim Dawn, a ARPG in the vein of Diablo 2. It's certainly one of the best Diablo clones, with dual classing, fun combat, and atmospheric tunes. There's no quest markers in this one so prepare for exploration, but there's nothing too round about with quests in this game, so don't worry about being constantly lost. Depends on how much you like Diablo clones, but I believe it was well worth the 15 bucks.
